nodes.description: Private constant bytes32 BADGE_ADMIN = "Admin", the badge stamped on admins and mods.
Private constant bytes32 BADGE_MOD = "Mod", declared but never actually used (addMod wrongly stamps BADGE_ADMIN).
Public bytes32 currentBadge ("Pioneer" by default) copied onto every newly added provider.
Util.List private _admins registry used by the onlyAdmins authorization gate.
Util.List private _mods registry used by the onlyMods authorization gate.
Util.List private _providers registry holding provider objects, activation/rejection flags and badges.
msg.sender: used both as the deployer privilege in the constructor and as the subject of every Util.isObject authorization check in onlyAdmins/onlyMods.
Constructor: adds msg.sender to _admins and _mods with BADGE_ADMIN, making the deployer the sole initial privileged account.
Modifier onlyAdmins: require(Util.isObject(_admins, msg.sender) == true), the admin authorization gate.
Modifier onlyMods: require(Util.isObject(_mods, msg.sender) == true), the moderator authorization gate for the provider lifecycle.
addAdmin(address) onlyAdmins: registers a new admin if not already present and transitively calls addMod(_addr).
removeAdmin(address) onlyAdmins: marks an admin object as not-an-object and transitively calls removeMod(_addr).
View helper returning whether an address is present in _admins.
addMod(address) onlyAdmins public: adds a moderator; because it is public and onlyAdmins-guarded, it can also be invoked directly by any admin, and it is re-entered internally from addAdmin.
removeMod(address) onlyAdmins public: removes a moderator from _mods; also reachable internally from removeAdmin.
View helper returning whether an address is present in _mods.
addProvider(address) onlyMods: reverts if the address is already an object, otherwise adds it with the current global badge.
removeProvider(address) onlyMods: reverts if the address is not an object, otherwise flags it as removed.
activateProvider(address) onlyMods: reverts if already active, otherwise sets isActive.
deactivateProvider(address) onlyMods: reverts if not active, otherwise clears isActive.
acceptProvider(address) onlyMods: reverts unless the provider is currently rejected, then clears the rejection flag.
rejectProvider(address) onlyMods: reverts if already rejected, otherwise sets the rejection flag.
View helper returning whether an address is present in _providers.
View helper returning the activation flag of a provider.
View helper returning the rejection flag of a provider.
View helper returning the stored insertion index of a provider.
View helper returning the badge bytes32 stored for a provider.
View helper returning Util.length(_providers), the total ever-added provider count.
setCurrentBadge(bytes32) onlyAdmins: privileged setter that changes the badge applied to future providers.
Anonymous payable fallback that unconditionally reverts, refusing plain ETH transfers.
Util.add(List storage,address,bytes32): writes isObject/index/badge and increments list.length.
Util.remove(List storage,address): only clears isObject; it never decrements list.length, leaving stale accounting.
Util.activate: sets the isActive flag to true.
Util.deactivate: sets the isActive flag to false.
Util.accept: clears the isRejected flag.
Util.reject: sets the isRejected flag to true.
Util.isObject: membership predicate; the sole primitive behind every authorization decision in this contract.
Util.isActive: reads the isActive flag.
Util.isRejected: reads the isRejected flag.
Util.indexOf: reads the stored index of a registry entry (0 for unknown addresses).
Util.getBadge: reads the bytes32 badge of a registry entry.
Util.length: returns the monotonically increasing list length.
list.length++ inside Util.add: unchecked Solidity 0.4.21 increment of a uint (arithmetic overflow possible) and the only counter that is never decremented by Util.remove.
require(Util.isObject(_admins, msg.sender) == true): the access-control decision protecting all admin-only entry points; it trusts msg.sender and a mutable registry entry.
require(Util.isObject(_mods, msg.sender) == true): the access-control decision protecting the whole provider lifecycle.
Parameter _addr of addAdmin(address).
Parameter _addr of removeAdmin(address).
Parameter _addr of addMod(address).
Parameter _addr of addProvider(address).
Parameter _badge of setCurrentBadge(bytes32).
Parameter _addr of Util.add(List,address,bytes32).
Parameter _badge of Util.add(List,address,bytes32).
Parameter _addr of Util.remove(List,address).
Implicit local copy of state variable currentBadge read inside addProvider and written into the provider registry entry by Util.add.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the subject of Util.isObject(_admins, ...) inside the onlyAdmins modifier, so the caller identity directly decides the authorization outcome.
msg.sender is the subject of Util.isObject(_mods, ...) inside the onlyMods modifier, gating the entire provider lifecycle.
msg.sender flows into the require() that guards admin-only operations.
msg.sender flows into the require() that guards moderator-only operations.
The constructor grants msg.sender the BADGE_ADMIN entry in both _admins and _mods, creating a single privileged deployer.
Constructor writes the deployer entry into the _admins registry.
Constructor writes the deployer entry into the _mods registry.
onlyAdmins guards addAdmin; the admin gate must pass before the privileged write is reachable.
onlyAdmins guards removeAdmin.
addMod is public and onlyAdmins-guarded; any address present in _admins can call it directly, independently of addAdmin.
removeMod is public and onlyAdmins-guarded.
setCurrentBadge is onlyAdmins-guarded, so an admin can silently change the badge given to all future providers.
onlyMods guards addProvider.
onlyMods guards removeProvider.
onlyMods guards activateProvider.
onlyMods guards deactivateProvider.
onlyMods guards acceptProvider.
onlyMods guards rejectProvider.
The onlyAdmins modifier body is exactly the unsafe_admin_require check, so the edge records the gate implementation.
The onlyMods modifier body is exactly the unsafe_mod_require check, so the edge records the gate implementation.
addAdmin mutates the _admins registry through Util.add, extending the privileged set.
addAdmin calls the library helper Util.add(_admins, _addr, BADGE_ADMIN).
addAdmin branches on Util.isObject(_admins, _addr) before granting privileges.
addAdmin internally calls the public onlyAdmins function addMod(_addr), so a single guarded call grants both admin and moderator membership (transitive privilege grant).
removeAdmin clears the isObject flag of an admin entry.
removeAdmin branches on Util.isObject(_admins, _addr) before revoking privileges.
removeAdmin calls Util.remove(_admins, _addr).
removeAdmin internally calls removeMod(_addr), revoking moderator status as a side effect of admin removal.
isAdmin exposes the raw Util.isObject(_admins, _addr) membership predicate.
addMod writes a new moderator entry into _mods, widening the set of accounts that pass onlyMods.
addMod calls Util.add(_mods, _addr, BADGE_ADMIN); note it stamps BADGE_ADMIN instead of BADGE_MOD.
addMod branches on Util.isObject(_mods, _addr).
removeMod clears the isObject flag of a moderator entry.
removeMod branches on Util.isObject(_mods, _addr).
removeMod calls Util.remove(_mods, _addr).
isMod exposes Util.isObject(_mods, _addr) as an authorization oracle.
addProvider inserts a new provider object into the _providers registry.
addProvider reverts unless Util.isObject(_providers, _addr) == false (duplicate guard).
addProvider calls Util.add(_providers, _addr, currentBadge).
addProvider reads the mutable state variable currentBadge and copies it into the new provider entry.
removeProvider flags an existing provider as removed but leaves list.length untouched.
removeProvider reverts unless Util.isObject(_providers, _addr) == true.
removeProvider calls Util.remove(_providers, _addr).
activateProvider sets isActive on the provider entry.
activateProvider reverts if Util.isActive(_providers, _addr) == true.
activateProvider calls Util.activate(_providers, _addr).
deactivateProvider clears isActive on the provider entry.
deactivateProvider reverts if Util.isActive(_providers, _addr) == false.
deactivateProvider calls Util.deactivate(_providers, _addr).
acceptProvider clears the isRejected flag on the provider entry.
acceptProvider reverts if Util.isRejected(_providers, _addr) == false.
acceptProvider calls Util.accept(_providers, _addr).
rejectProvider sets the isRejected flag on the provider entry.
rejectProvider reverts if Util.isRejected(_providers, _addr) == true.
rejectProvider calls Util.reject(_providers, _addr).
isProvider exposes Util.isObject(_providers, _addr).
isActive exposes Util.isActive(_providers, _addr).
isRejected exposes Util.isRejected(_providers, _addr).
indexOfProvider exposes Util.indexOf(_providers, _addr).
getProviderBadge exposes Util.getBadge(_providers, _addr).
sizeOfProviders exposes Util.length(_providers), the never-decremented counter.
setCurrentBadge writes the privileged badge value into the mutable currentBadge state variable.
Constructor calls Util.add twice to seed the admin and moderator registries.
Util.add performs the unchecked list.length++ increment (Solidity 0.4.x has no overflow protection and remove never decrements it).
The increment directly determines the value later returned by Util.length/sizeOfProviders, so the counter is the observable arithmetic state.
_addr is the input address governing which account addAdmin targets.
_addr received by addAdmin is forwarded unchanged into the internal addMod call.
_addr flows through addAdmin into Util.add(_admins, _addr, BADGE_ADMIN).
_addr is the input address governing which account removeAdmin targets.
_addr flows through removeAdmin into Util.remove(_admins, _addr).
_addr is the input address governing which account addMod targets.
_addr flows through addMod into Util.add(_mods, _addr, BADGE_ADMIN).
_addr is the input address governing which account addProvider targets.
_addr flows through addProvider into Util.add(_providers, _addr, currentBadge).
_badge is the privileged value accepted by setCurrentBadge.
_badge is written verbatim into the currentBadge state variable, changing the badge of all subsequently added providers.
_addr is the registry key written by the library helper Util.add.
_badge is the value stored under the badge field of the registry entry in Util.add.
_addr is the registry key cleared by the library helper Util.remove.
The implicit copy of currentBadge taken in addProvider is supplied as the _badge argument to Util.add and persisted for the provider.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _addr only exists to key the addAdmin privileged write and has no independent semantic identity.
Parameter _addr only exists to key the removeAdmin privileged write.
Parameter _addr only exists as the key of the addMod privileged write.
Parameter _addr only exists as the key of the addProvider registry insertion.
Parameter _badge is the sole input of the privileged setCurrentBadge setter.
Parameter _addr is consumed directly by Util.add as the registry key and should collapse into that mutation.
Parameter _badge is consumed directly by Util.add when stamping the registry entry.
Parameter _addr is consumed directly by Util.remove as the registry key.
The implicit local copy of currentBadge exists only for the addProvider -> Util.add argument passing and should be folded into addProvider.
